summary: Captures Windows Kinect color, depth, infrared, player-index, and point-cloud images from Kinect for Windows hardware.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Capture data from the Kinect sensor

key_params.name: sensor
key_params.note: Kinect sensor index for Kinect v1

key_params.name: image
key_params.note: Image stream: color, depth, rawdepth, infrared, playerindex, or colorpointcloud

key_params.name: skeleton
key_params.note: Kinect v1 skeleton mode: full or seated

key_params.name: neardepthmode
key_params.note: Enable Kinect v1 near depth mode

key_params.name: remap
key_params.note: Remap Kinect 2 depth images to color space

common_gotchas: Install the matching Kinect SDK/runtime before expecting data.
Many settings are v1-only or v2-only; do not assume every parameter applies to both devices.
Player-index values are approximate 8-bit increments, not exact decimal IDs.
Color point cloud requires float/point-cloud-aware downstream handling.
key_concepts: Kinect TOP is supported only on Microsoft Windows.
It supports Kinect for Windows hardware and Kinect 2, not Kinect for Xbox hardware.
Image modes include color, depth, raw depth, infrared, player index, and Kinect 2 color point cloud.
Kinect 2 color point cloud outputs 32-bit float RGB textures where RGB stores XYZ meters.
Kinect 1 and Kinect 2 have different parameter availability and runtime requirements.
Kinect 2 remap can align depth-related images into color camera space.
